name: Rahat Sayyed
summary: Full stack Software Engineer with 3+ years of experience building React and Next.js frontends backed by Node.js REST APIs. Cares about UI quality and product outcomes: refactored React state management to cut initial load time by 11 seconds, and optimized build workflows to save ~10 minutes per cycle.

experience.title: Software Engineer
description: Directed a system-wide refactor of React state management, eliminating 9+ redundant API calls and reducing initial load time by 11 seconds.

Designed multi-policy schemas and contract-driven TypeScript APIs, reducing integration-related regressions by 70% as product interfaces evolved.
Developed D3-based interactive risk analytics dashboards that made LLM vs. tool exposure patterns easy to read, accelerating policy debugging across 12+ policies.
Optimized Docker-based frontend build pipeline on AWS EC2 by restructuring dependency installation and leveraging layer caching, reducing development build times by ~10 minutes.
Coordinated cross-functional efforts between frontend, backend, and AI teams, integrating 3+ evolving model capabilities while keeping product behavior consistent as new tools were introduced.
